# NEW FILE

Start a new, empty active dataset.

## Syntax

```text
NEW FILE.
```

A named active dataset stays open under its name; an unnamed one is gone.

## Example

```text
NEW FILE.
```

`statscraft help NEW FILE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
